\usepackage{amsmath,booktabs}

\begin{document}
Common image transforms and their matrices.

\begin{tabular}{lcl}
\toprule
Transform & Matrix & Use \\
\midrule
Scale & $\begin{pmatrix} 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 \end{pmatrix}$ & zoom \\

Shear & $\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$ & slant \\

Flip & $\begin{pmatrix} -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{pmatrix}$ & mirror \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

The editor applies them in this order.
\end{document}
